title: RF Compare
description: Independent concordance, normalized error, dB differences and sector-weighted agreement.
settings: Magnitude mode; six matched azimuths per case, yielding two contiguous three-sample sectors.
scope: Validates the defined metric arithmetic on positive synthetic powers. The RF index is a chosen scoring policy, not a universal physical-quality certificate.

notes: metrics.csv contains the direct numerical output of GRIM RF Compare; worksheet actuals are read back from that file.
The six-point sectors are [0,10,20] and [30,40,50] deg. Equal constant traces have CCC=1; unequal constants have CCC=0.
Insufficient positive pairs: RF agreement requires at least two positive finite matched samples
